parsed.reason: Description A identifies a defect where the try block also wraps the batch flush, so sink failures (SinkError) are misreported as rejected rows and up to batch_size rows are lost silently. Description B describes a behaviour change where malformed rows are skipped instead of aborting, requiring callers to check report.clean. These concern different failures: one is a sink-error misclassification causing data loss, the other is an intentional API semantics change for bad input.
